entries.title: Fix GitHub authentication and connection errors
entries.summary: Diagnose why clone/pull/push cannot talk to GitHub.
entries.when: Any 'fatal:' error mentioning access, authentication or network.
entries.where: Inside the repository (or any folder for the SSH test).

steps.label: 1. Is the remote HTTPS or SSH?
steps.dir: Inside the cloned repository (the project root)

steps.label: 2. Test SSH auth
steps.dir: Any directory

steps.label: 3. Verbose output shows which key is offered
steps.dir: Any directory

entries.expected: Step 2 prints: 'Hi USERNAME! You've successfully authenticated, but GitHub does not provide shell access.'
troubleshooting: Permission denied (publickey): key not loaded or not added to GitHub. Run ssh-add -l; see SSH menu.
Authentication failed (HTTPS): passwords are not accepted; use a Personal Access Token, 'gh auth login', or switch to SSH.
Repository not found: typo in URL, or no access to a private repo (wrong GitHub account).
Could not resolve host / timed out: check internet/VPN; if port 22 is blocked use SSH over port 443 (SSH menu).
Host key verification failed: type 'yes' at the first-connect prompt; never ignore a changed-key warning on a trusted network.
failed to push some refs (non-fast-forward): run 'git pull' first, resolve conflicts, push again.
